description: A scoped formula whose symbol support is contained in \(S\) restricts to a formula in the sublanguage determined by \(S\), preserving its variable and placeholder contexts.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.restrictFormula.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (S : Finset L.Symbols) {n : ℕ} (A : L.BoundedFormula α n) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols A ⊆ S →
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportedLanguage S).BoundedFormula α n
